actions.clarify_request: Ask the user a focused question to resolve their request
actions.draft_in_conversation: Create or revise text for review in chat
actions.write_current_page: Stage a change to the active authored page
actions.read_source: Consult or find saved campaign sources
actions.review_connected_page: Prepare a new page with a requested connection
actions.save_page: Commit an existing authored page change
actions.plan: Prepare a named work plan with reviewable steps.
actions.continue_work_plan: Continue a selected step of an existing work plan
actions.choice_option: Create or change a Plan branch or option
actions.change_mechanics: Create or revise persistent statblock mechanics
actions.review_variant_approval: Open save confirmation for a creature statblock already drafted in this conversation.
actions.build_encounter: Prepare a runnable encounter or roster
actions.preview_encounter: Open the preview of a prepared encounter
actions.prepare_image: Prepare an image direction or prompt
actions.place_image: Insert, replace, or move an existing image
actions.map_navigation: Open or navigate a map or its linked location
actions.name_correction: Review source wording or name corrections before extraction
actions.identity_review: Resolve competing existing identities before reconciliation
actions.publish_extraction: Verify and publish reviewed extraction or replace a published revision
actions.play_dispatch: Start or advance the prepared live session along an existing outcome.
actions.play_edit: Stage an edit to the content of the active session copy.
actions.open_table: Open a prepared Play table without resolving a roll.
actions.record_roll: Record a supplied result against the active table or check
actions.played_recap: Draft a recap from recorded play
actions.recover_request: Recover a saved attempt or inspect its outcome
actions.operator_handoff: Open the owning surface or guide the user there
actions.needs_context_to_choose: Defer the decision because the available text does not resolve the intent.
